Choosing the right January intake universities in UK can help international students who need an alternative start date after missing the main September intake. For 2027 entry, several UK universities are opening January programmes, especially for postgraduate students in areas such as Business, Computing, Engineering, Finance and Management.

The short answer is simple: January intake exists, but it does not work like the September intake.

Many students assume that if a university offers January admission, every course will be available. That is not how UK admissions work. A university may offer a January start for an MSc in Business Management while keeping another similar course available only in September.

This guide covers the latest January intake UK universities for 2027, including postgraduate and undergraduate options, deadlines, popular courses and important application information for international students.

Who Should Choose January Intake UK 2027?

The January 2027 intake can be a practical choice for students who need more flexibility with their UK study plans.

It is especially suitable for:

  • Students who missed the September 2026 intake
  • Students completing their previous degree in late 2026
  • Applicants who need additional time to prepare English test results
  • International applicants looking for selected postgraduate opportunities

Here’s the thing. January intake is not a backup option for unsuccessful applicants. Many students intentionally choose it because it matches their academic timeline better.

For example, a student completing a Bachelor’s degree in November 2026 may not want to wait until September 2027 for the next major intake. A suitable January 2027 Masters programme can reduce that waiting period and help the student continue their academic journey sooner.

However, students should remember that January intake offers fewer course choices compared with September. The right decision depends on your preferred subject, university availability and career goals.

List of January Intake Universities in UK 2027

The number of January intake universities in UK is smaller compared with September entry, but international students can still explore a range of recognised institutions offering selected programmes for 2027.

The table below highlights universities with January 2027 entry opportunities, example study areas and the types of programmes available.

University Examples of January 2027 Study Areas Entry Options
University of Liverpool Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering and selected Health programmes Postgraduate
University of Strathclyde Advanced Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Business and Management Postgraduate
University of Birmingham Computer Science, Advanced Engineering Management, Education and Business Postgraduate
Queen Mary University of London Management, Marketing, Finance and selected specialist programmes Postgraduate
University of Portsmouth Business, Computing, Engineering and Project Management Selected Undergraduate, Top-Up and Postgraduate routes
Northumbria University MBA, Business and selected specialist programmes Postgraduate and selected campus-specific Undergraduate Top-Up routes
Brunel University of London International Business and selected specialist Masters programmes Postgraduate
Loughborough University International Relations, Design Innovation, Digital Marketing and International Business Management Postgraduate at the London campus

Important: January entry is available only for specified courses. Undergraduate options may include top-up, foundation or pathway programmes rather than standard first-year entry. Availability, campus, study mode, eligibility and application deadlines must be confirmed on the individual university course pages.

Tuition fees vary by programme, campus and academic year. Students should check the published international tuition fee for their chosen January 2027 course rather than relying on a general university-wide estimate.

UK Universities With January Intake Postgraduate 2027

For international applicants, UK universities with January intake postgraduate 2027 options provide the widest range of choices.

This is where January intake becomes more practical.

Most available programmes focus on career-oriented subjects such as:

  • Business Management
  • International Business
  • Computer Science
  • Data Science
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Engineering Management
  • Finance
  • Marketing
  • Public Health

A surprising point many students miss: January intake does not automatically mean easier admission. Universities may have fewer available places because they run smaller cohorts.

University of Liverpool

The University of Liverpool is a recognised option for international students exploring January 2027 postgraduate entry.

Selected January-start Masters programmes are available across areas including:

  • Business and Management
  • Advanced Computer Science
  • Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
  • Engineering
  • Selected Healthcare and Allied Health subjects

For example, students interested in technology-related postgraduate study can explore Advanced Computer Science MSc and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence MSc programmes.

An important detail for January 2027 applicants is that the university's welcome activities begin on 25 January 2027, while teaching starts on 1 February 2027 for the listed programmes.

Students can find confirmed courses, entry requirements and application dates through the University of Liverpool's official January postgraduate course list.

Applicants should verify the exact programme requirements and international application deadline before applying.

University of Strathclyde

The University of Strathclyde offers a selection of postgraduate taught programmes starting in January 2027 across its academic faculties.

Examples of January 2027 programmes include:

  • Advanced Computer Science MSc
  • Advanced Computer Science with Data Science MSc
  • Advanced Computer Science with Cyber Security MSc
  • Advanced Mechanical Engineering MSc
  • Finance MSc
  • Business and Management MSc
  • Digital Marketing Management MSc
  • Marketing MSc

This range makes Strathclyde worth considering for students interested in Computing, Engineering, Finance and Management.

However, not every Masters programme is available in January. Applicants should check the official January 2027 postgraduate programme list before choosing a course.

University of Birmingham

The University of Birmingham offers selected postgraduate taught programmes for January 2027 entry.

Confirmed programme areas include:

  • Advanced Computer Science MSc
  • Computer Science MSc
  • Advanced Engineering Management MSc
  • Education MA
  • International Business MSc
  • Financial Management MSc
  • Public Management MSc
  • Masters in Public Administration (MPA)

These options cover a range of technology, education, business and management subjects.

However, January admission is available only for specified courses. A university offering January entry does not mean that every programme accepts applications for that intake.

For most overseas postgraduate taught applicants, the published January 2027 application deadline is 30 October 2026. Some programmes may have different requirements or deadlines.

Students should verify their preferred course and admission conditions directly with the university.

Queen Mary University of London

Queen Mary University of London offers selected January 2027 Masters and Pre-Masters programmes across several subject areas.

Examples include:

  • Management MSc
  • Marketing MSc
  • Banking and Finance MSc
  • Financial Data Analytics MSc
  • Artificial Intelligence (Conversion) MSc
  • Selected Law and specialist postgraduate programmes

Students comparing London-based universities should consider course content, tuition fees, accommodation and personal living expenses before making a decision.

Applicants can explore the university's confirmed courses through its official January 2027 programme page.

Course availability, fees and admission requirements should be checked individually.

More January Intake UK Universities for 2027

Loughborough University

Loughborough University offers a selection of full-time Masters programmes starting in January 2027 at its London campus.

Available subject areas include:

  • International Relations
  • International Business Management
  • Design Innovation
  • Digital Marketing
  • Finance and Management
  • Digital Finance and Artificial Intelligence
  • Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management

One important distinction is that these January-start programmes are offered at Loughborough University's London campus rather than its main Leicestershire campus.

Students should therefore consider the course location, published tuition fees and accommodation costs before applying.

The university provides an official January 2027 Masters programme list with course-level information.

Brunel University London

Brunel University of London offers January entry for selected postgraduate programmes across Business, Computing, Engineering and Management.

Examples of January-start courses include:

  • International Business MSc
  • Artificial Intelligence MSc
  • Engineering Management MSc
  • Management MSc
  • Finance and Accounting MSc

These programmes may appeal to international students seeking specialist postgraduate study in business, technology and professional management.

However, course availability, fees and study duration depend on the selected programme.

For January 2027 entry, Brunel recommends submitting postgraduate applications by 13 November 2026. Applications after this date may be considered where places and processing time allow.

Students should confirm the relevant admission requirements and application status through the university's official course information.

University of Portsmouth

The University of Portsmouth offers selected undergraduate, postgraduate and pathway programmes for January 2027 entry.

An important consideration is that January course availability differs between the Portsmouth campus and the University of Portsmouth London campus.

Examples include:

  • Engineering and Computing Top-Up degrees at the Portsmouth campus
  • Selected postgraduate Engineering and Applied Sciences programmes
  • Business and Management undergraduate options at the London campus
  • Computing and Artificial Intelligence undergraduate options at the London campus
  • Project Management and Engineering Management postgraduate programmes at the London campus
  • Selected foundation and Pre-Masters pathways

Students should distinguish between standard undergraduate degrees, top-up qualifications and pathway programmes because these options have different academic requirements.

Application deadlines may also vary by campus and applicant nationality.

The university publishes its January 2027 options through its official January course list.

Applicants should confirm their intended campus, course availability, entry conditions and relevant deadline before applying.

Northumbria University

Northumbria University provides January 2027 postgraduate entry opportunities, including selected Business and Management programmes.

One confirmed option is the Master of Business Administration (MBA), offered as a full-time postgraduate programme at the Newcastle City Campus.

Northumbria University London also lists selected undergraduate Business and Management Top-Up programmes with January start options.

Students considering Northumbria should pay particular attention to the course location and study mode, as programmes offered through the Newcastle and London campuses may differ.

Applicants should confirm whether their chosen course is available for January 2027, whether it is campus-based or delivered through another study mode, and whether they meet the academic entry requirements.

UK Universities With January Intake Undergraduate 2027

Finding UK universities with January intake undergraduate programmes requires careful course-level research because undergraduate availability is more limited than postgraduate entry.

Many January undergraduate options are specialised top-up programmes, accelerated degrees or university pathway routes rather than standard three-year Bachelor's programmes.

Examples of January 2027 undergraduate opportunities include:

University January 2027 Undergraduate Options Important Details
University of Portsmouth Selected Engineering and Computing Top-Up programmes; Business, Computing and other courses at the London campus Course options vary between Portsmouth and London campuses
Northumbria University Selected Business and Management Top-Up programmes Check the London campus, delivery mode and individual course details
University of Dundee International Business BSc (Hons) January 2027 accelerated undergraduate entry
Anglia Ruskin University International Business BSc (Hons) Top-Up January 2027 entry at Cambridge
Birmingham City University Business Management BA (Hons) January 2027 entry is listed, but nationality-specific application restrictions apply

Birmingham City University states that it cannot accept undergraduate applications from applicants in Bangladesh under its published January 2027 international admissions arrangements. Students from other countries should also check their eligibility directly with the university.

Students should confirm whether a course offers standard first-year admission, advanced entry, top-up study or a pathway programme. These routes have different academic requirements and may not be suitable for every applicant.

Students who are comparing different UK admission periods can also explore information about September intake universities in UK before choosing the most suitable timeline.

UK January Intake 2027 Deadline

The UK January intake 2027 deadline varies between universities, courses and applicant categories. There is no single national application deadline for January entry.

The following published dates provide useful examples for students planning postgraduate or other eligible January 2027 applications.

University Published January 2027 Application Deadline
University of Birmingham 30 October 2026 for most overseas postgraduate taught applications
Brunel University of London 13 November 2026 recommended postgraduate application date
Royal Holloway, University of London 7 December 2026 for January postgraduate courses; later applications considered individually
Kingston University London 11 December 2026 for standard January international admissions
Queen Mary University of London 14 December 2026 for overseas postgraduate applications; some courses close earlier
University of Liverpool 18 December 2026 for most international postgraduate applications; selected Engineering courses close on 30 November 2026

These dates are based on published university information and may differ for individual programmes. Recommended application dates should not be treated as guaranteed final deadlines.

Some universities also set earlier deadlines depending on the applicant's country of residence. For example, the University of Portsmouth lists 2 November 2026 as the new-application deadline for January 2027 Portsmouth-campus applicants from Bangladesh and several other specified countries.

Students should always verify the latest deadlines through official university sources. The University of Liverpool's postgraduate application information and the University of Portsmouth's international application deadlines provide useful examples of university-specific requirements and application timelines.

Applying earlier can provide more time to meet university admission conditions, arrange academic documents and complete enrolment requirements.

Students planning undergraduate applications can also review our guide on how to apply through UCAS before starting their application journey.

Best Courses in UK With January Intake 2027

Students searching for January intake universities in UK often focus only on the university name. However, the course choice usually matters more.

A January start is valuable only when the programme matches your academic background, career plan and budget.

For example, a student with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science may find several January Masters options in Artificial Intelligence or Data Science, while someone looking for a specialised undergraduate programme may have fewer choices.

Examples of subject areas students may explore for January 2027 entry include the following. The availability of individual courses depends on the university, programme and start date.

Here’s the thing. Many international students choose January because they want a faster transition after completing their previous qualification. A student graduating in late 2026, for example, may avoid waiting almost a full year by selecting a suitable January 2027 Masters programme.

Students who are still deciding which subject fits their career goals can also compare options through our guide on best courses to study in the UK.

January Intake UK 2027 Fees and Tuition Costs

Tuition fees for January intake UK universities vary depending on the institution, course, campus, study level and academic year.

Students should not assume that a January-start programme will have the same fee as a September-start programme, even when the course title is identical.

For international applicants, the published fee for the exact January 2027 course is the most reliable starting point for calculating tuition expenses.

The following examples illustrate published international tuition fees for selected January-start programmes.

University Programme Published International Tuition Fee
Queen Mary University of London Management MSc, January 2027 £35,250
Brunel University of London International Business MSc, 2026/27 academic year £24,795
Loughborough University London International Relations MSc, January 2027 £21,300, including the published £5,000 London anniversary award

These figures are course-specific examples and should not be interpreted as the tuition fees of all programmes at the universities listed.

At Loughborough University London, the published January 2027 International Relations MSc international fee reflects a specific award arrangement. Eligibility, award conditions and restrictions on combining scholarships should be checked directly with the university.

When comparing tuition fees, students should review:

  • The exact programme and January 2027 start date
  • International or overseas fee status
  • Course duration and campus location
  • Any published scholarship or fee discount
  • University deposit and payment conditions

Tuition fees can change between academic years and may differ between courses at the same university. Students should verify all figures through official university course pages before making financial commitments.

Living Costs for International Students in the UK

Tuition fees are only one part of the budget.

International students also need to consider:

  • Accommodation
  • Food
  • Transport
  • Study materials
  • Health-related costs
  • Personal expenses

Living costs vary significantly depending on location.

London usually costs more than cities such as Liverpool, Portsmouth or Lincoln.

Think about it this way: two students studying the same course can have completely different monthly costs because accommodation choices often create the biggest difference.

Scholarships for January Intake Universities in UK 2027

Many international students want to know whether scholarships are available for January 2027 entry.

Selected UK universities offer scholarships, tuition fee discounts and other awards for eligible January-start students. However, availability depends on the university, course, nationality, fee status and published award conditions.

University January 2027 Scholarship Information
University of Strathclyde Selected international postgraduate taught scholarships, including faculty-based awards
Queen Mary University of London Global Scholarship scheme worth up to £7,000 for eligible students on selected programmes
University of Lincoln South Asia Scholarship worth £3,000 to £5,000 for eligible postgraduate students from specified countries

For January 2027, the University of Strathclyde publishes automatic scholarships for eligible international postgraduate taught students, with award values varying by faculty and programme.

Queen Mary University of London also offers its Global Scholarship scheme for eligible applicants to selected January 2027 programmes.

The University of Lincoln's South Asia Scholarship is subject to specific nationality and academic conditions. Its published scheme covers eligible applicants from India, Nepal and Sri Lanka and should not be assumed to apply to every South Asian nationality.

Some university awards are considered automatically, while others may have separate application requirements or deadlines. A scholarship is not guaranteed simply because a student receives a university offer.

Students should review the relevant scholarship's full eligibility criteria and terms directly through official university information.

Useful official references include the University of Strathclyde postgraduate scholarship information and the University of Lincoln South Asia Scholarship.

Entry Requirements for January Intake UK Universities

Entry requirements for UK universities with January intake postgraduate 2027 options are usually similar to September intake requirements.

Universities normally consider:

  • Previous academic qualifications
  • Degree subject and grades
  • English language ability
  • Personal statement
  • References
  • Professional experience where required

For postgraduate courses, many UK universities commonly ask for:

  • A recognised Bachelor’s degree
  • Academic transcripts
  • English proficiency evidence
  • Personal statement or statement of purpose

English requirements vary by university and programme.

Many Masters programmes accept IELTS scores around 6.0 to 6.5, but students should always confirm the exact requirement for their chosen course.

Some universities may accept alternative English tests or previous English-medium education depending on their policy.

Students comparing English requirements can also review our guide on English language requirements for UK universities.

Documents Required for January Intake UK 2027 Applications

Preparing documents early makes the application process smoother.

Most international students need:

  • Valid passport
  • Academic certificates
  • Academic transcripts
  • English language certificate
  • Personal statement
  • Reference letters
  • CV for relevant programmes
  • Portfolio for selected subjects
  • Additional documents specified by the university for admission or enrolment.

Some students underestimate document preparation.

A missing transcript or delayed reference letter can slow down the entire process, especially when applying close to the UK January intake 2027 deadline.

A simple approach works best:

How to Apply for January Intake Universities in UK 2027

The application process usually follows these steps:

Step 1: Choose the Right Course

Start with the subject, not only the university name.

A university may have January entry, but your preferred course may not.

Step 2: Check January Course Availability

Always confirm:

  • Course start date
  • Entry requirements
  • Tuition fees
  • Application deadline

Official university course pages provide the most accurate information.

Step 3: Prepare Your Application Documents

Prepare:

  • Academic records
  • English test results
  • Personal statement
  • References
  • CV if required

Step 4: Submit the Application

Most postgraduate applicants apply directly through the university website.

Some undergraduate applicants may need to use UCAS depending on the course.

Step 5: Accept Your University Offer and Review Official Entry Information

After receiving an offer, students normally need to:

  • Meet conditions
  • Pay required deposits

Frequently Asked Questions About January Intake Universities in UK 2027

Which UK universities have January intake for MBA programmes?

Several UK universities offer January MBA or business-related postgraduate routes, although availability depends on the institution and academic year.

Students should check the specific MBA course page because some universities only offer MBA programmes in September.

Which universities have January intake in UK 2027?

Popular options include:

  • University of Liverpool
  • University of Strathclyde
  • University of Birmingham
  • Queen Mary University of London
  • University of Portsmouth
  • Northumbria University
  • Brunel University London
  • Loughborough University

Course availability depends on the specific programme.

Are January intake universities in UK available for international students?

Yes. Many UK universities offer January entry for international students, especially for postgraduate programmes.

What is the UK January intake 2027 deadline?

There is no single deadline.

Most universities set their own dates, and international students should ideally apply several months before January 2027.

Can undergraduate students apply for January intake UK universities?

Yes, but options are limited compared with postgraduate courses.

Students should confirm the exact course start date before applying.

Is January intake better than September intake?

Neither intake suits every student.

January works well for students who need a later start date, while September offers the widest university and course selection.

Final Thoughts

Choosing the right January intake universities in UK requires more than finding a university with a January start date.

Before applying, compare:

  • Available courses
  • Tuition fees
  • Entry requirements
  • Scholarship opportunities
  • Application deadlines

The best January 2027 option is the one that matches your academic background and career plan.

Planning early can make the process much easier. If you need support with university selection, application preparation or your UK study pathway, our free consultation service can help you review the next steps.
